channel.description: I'm Boris Tane, and I build software

item.title: On-Call Is Now Theatre
item.description: On-call was calibrated to the cost of waking up a human. That cost just went to zero. Self-operating software is coming, and your rotation is the last thing standing in its way.
item.author: Boris Tane

item.title: Slop Creep: The Great Enshittification of Software
item.description: Coding agents didn't make poor engineers dangerous. They made them unstoppable.
item.author: Boris Tane

item.title: The Software Development Lifecycle Is Dead
item.description: AI agents didn't make the SDLC faster. They killed it. All that's left is context.
item.author: Boris Tane
